primary_doc_evidence_from_root.source_claim: Nominal Euro pallet dimensions vary by a few centimeters; static annotation accuracy is expected at low-centimeter scale.

scope.unit_evidence: BOP 3D model/translation and scaled depth convention in mm; confirm MR release-specific model/pose/depth consistency separately.
scope.provided_projection: Deterministic nominal model reference from supplied pose/K; not certified true semantic corner at <=3px.
scope.no_tiny_error_gold: Do not certify coordinate correctness, derive exact query-support labels, or validate a <=3px precision cohort from MR nominal projections alone.
scope.label_evidence: Semantic expected part and external blockage may be visually defensible despite nominal pose error; record geometry/reference uncertainty, image-boundary proximity and identity ambiguity separately.
scope.mask_boundary: A projected point crossing a full/visible mask edge may reflect nominal dimensions/pose/depth uncertainty, self edge or mesh hole. It is not automatic D/E.
scope.unclear_cases: Leave unsupported native role/semantic visibility or uncertainty boundary as U/evidence-limited. Do not make exact mesh-surface membership a universal prerequisite for every D.
scope.no_gt_teacher_input: No provided GT pose/uncertainty/permutation/reference or q-error is a classifier input, q recentering rule, or training filter.
